wildcat-strike.note: Corp chooses: Runner gains 6 credits or draws 4.

abilities: The Runner adds that icebreaker to the bottom of the stack.
will-o-the-wisp.note: Fixed in engine#1005: the upgrade is trashed first; the Corp then picks an icebreaker used to break this run (it alone if only one) and it goes to the bottom of the stack through the uninstall helper.
will-o-the-wisp.test: once the Corp trashes it, the icebreaker used this run goes to the bottom of the stack, not the heap; with none, it is still trashed (CR 1.2.1)

winchester.note: Trace 4: trash a program; trace 3: trash a hardware; while protecting HQ it gains 'trace 3: end the run' after its other subroutines.

windfall.note: Shuffle the stack, trash its top card, gain its install cost.

window.note: Click: draw 1 from the bottom of the stack.

abilities: You may install 1 program or piece of hardware from your grip.
window-of-opportunity.note: Area 6 (Runner install): may_install_from_grip drops programs over free MU, trojans and install-on-ice cards. The run, the derez at run begin and the Corp's free rez at run end match.

wireless-net-pavilion.note: Unique; the Corp's basic action to trash a resource costs 2 more.

witch-hunt.note: Bad publicity on score or steal; Corp action phase end after scoring it this turn: remove all tags, give 3.

witness-tampering.note: Additional cost of a click; remove up to 2 bad publicity.

woman-in-the-red-dress.note: Unique; Runner turn begins: reveal the top card of R&D and the Corp may draw it.

woodcutter.note: Advanceable only while rezzed; gains a 1 net damage subroutine per advancement counter. Confirmed in engine#1005 against CR 9.1.8f: the ability allowing it to be advanced is active while unrezzed, but its own text allows it only if rezzed (CR 1.2.1).

word-on-the-street.note: Unique; additional cost to score an agenda installed this turn: Corp adds it to their score area as a -1 agenda they cannot forfeit; when the Corp scores an agenda not installed this turn, trash it, gain 4, draw 1.

working-prototype.note: A power counter on every rez (itself included); [click], counter: gain 3; [click], 5 counters: gain 6 and add an installed resource to the top of the stack.

abilities: you may trash 1 of your other installed cards to search your stack for 1 card of the same type. Install the card you found, paying 3[credit] less.
world-tree.note: Area 6 (Runner install): searchStackTypeInstall uses the same filters, so a program that would exceed free MU, a trojan or an install-on-ice program cannot be found and installed. The once-per-turn trigger, the trash and the discount match.

abilities: [click]: Install an asset from HQ on Worlds Plaza and rez it, lowering its rez cost by 2, if able.
worlds-plaza.note: Area 7 (rez, a listed example): resolve_worlds_plaza writes the install onto Worlds Plaza and the rez directly (rezzed=true, credits taken by hand), so the rez procedure and when-rezzed abilities do not run. Refusing the install when the lowered rez cost cannot be paid follows 'if able' (1.2.3). Hosting up to 3 assets matches.

wormhole.note: Can be advanced, rez cost -3 per advancement; resolve a subroutine on another rezzed ice (mandatory).

abilities: [subroutine] End the run unless the Runner trashes 1 installed program.
wotan.note: Subroutine 3 is an ungated choose: 'Trash 1 installed program' is offered with no program installed, trash_program then does nothing and the run continues (1.16.11b, 1.16.1c). Subroutines 1, 2 and 4 use the gated unless and match; the shared unless has no program-trash cost (area 11).

wraparound.note: +7 strength while no fracter is installed (a set, so Şifr overrides it); end the run.

wyldside.note: Unique; when the turn begins draw 2 and lose 1 click.

wyrm.note: Interface 3: break 1 subroutine on ice with strength 0 or less; interface 1: the encountered ice gets -1 strength for the encounter; 1: +1 strength.

xanadu.note: Unique; every ice costs 1 more to rez.

yagura.note: Look at the top card of R&D and the Corp may add it to the bottom; 1 net damage.

abilities: Whenever a player trashes a card (including this upgrade) from the root of this server or protecting it, except during installation, gain 2[credit].
yakov-erikovich-avdakov.note: A trashed Yakov pays only if it was rezzed when trashed; other cards in its server pay only while Yakov is rezzed.
yakov-erikovich-avdakov.test: an unrezzed Yakov the Runner trashes gives the Corp nothing; a rezzed one gives 2 credits (CR 9.1.8g)

abilities: Interface → Any virus counter: Break 1 barrier subroutine. Any virus counter: +1 strength.
yusuf.note: Same as Musaazi: the counters are paid only from Yusuf. Placing a counter on a successful run and strength 3 match.

zahya-sadeghi-versatile-smuggler.note: Once per turn, when an HQ or R&D run ends, may gain 1 credit per card accessed.

zaibatsu-loyalty.note: When a card would be exposed the Corp may rez it; interrupt, 1 or [trash]: prevent 1 card from being exposed.

zamba.note: Unique console, +2 MU; may gain 1 whenever a Corp card is exposed (completeExpose).

zato-city-grid.note: Remote only; ice protecting this server: on encounter the Corp may trash it to resolve 1 chosen subroutine.

zealous-judge.note: Rez only if the Runner is tagged; click, 1 credit: give 1 tag.

abilities: [subroutine] If the Runner has lost [click] to break a subroutine during this run, do 1 core damage. (twice)
zed-1-0.note: Card JSON (cards v1.147.27, engine#1002 pins it) and engine: the break gate is gone; each subroutine does its core damage only if the Runner has lost a click to break this run (new condition lost_click_to_break_this_run). Zed 2.0 (S3j) keeps the old flag.
zed-1-0.test: can be broken by losing a click at once, and its subroutine does core damage only if the Runner has lost a click to break this run (CR 1.2.1, 9.8.5)

abilities: Subroutine If the Runner has lost [click] to break a subroutine during this run, do 2 core damage.
Lose [click][click]: Break up to 2 subroutines on this ice.
zed-2-0.note: The third subroutine's condition is modelled as requireLostClickToBreakThisRun, which only stops the Runner breaking that subroutine until they have lost a click to break; when it resolves it always does 2 core damage (its instruction is a plain core_damage with no condition), so a Runner who broke nothing with clicks takes 2 core damage. Fix-now candidate: a supported card deals core damage the text does not. The 1-click break_bioroid_subroutine is also offered beside the 2-click multi-break (area 11, as Nerine 2.0). The 2-click break of up to 2 subroutines and the two trash-hardware subroutines match. requireLostClickToBreakThisRun also stops the Runner targeting that subroutine until a click was lost, even inside the 2-click break that loses it; the card has no such restriction (9.8.6).

zenit-chip-jz-2mj.note: Unique; 1 core damage on install; first successful central run each turn draws 1.

zer0.note: Unique; once per turn, [click] and 1 net damage: gain 1 and draw 2.

zona-sul-shipping.note: 1 credit placed on it at turn begin; [click]: take all; trashed when the Runner is tagged.

zu-13-key-master.note: Interface 1 credit: break 1 code gate subroutine; 1 credit: +1 strength; memory cost 0 with at least 2 link.
